Serious axe-core violations each scanned page may still have, per theme: the most serious rules it may violate, and the rules that made up that count when it was set. A page or theme with no entry may have none. e2e/axe.ts fails a scan above its count and prints the lower entry when a fix lands. Lower entries as fixes land; never raise one. W11 brought the light-theme muted-text and azure-pill contrast to AA, so every page now holds at zero serious violations in both themes.
